scientific_limits: Approximate 25 C single-solute near-saturation/ambient-pressure limits, not universal maxima.
HCl/NaOH/KOH above 1 M are empirical-density stocks; no calibrated pH, ionic activities or reaction kinetics. Only same-solute mixing, aliquoting and water dilution.
HCl evaporation, thermal coupling and general crystal inventory not implemented.
NaOH/KOH/HCl handbook density values are approximate graph/table-derived estimates, not experimental validation. Other solutes retain prior model limits.
